$description: Stilet Dekor design tokens: the single source of the site's colors, type, spacing and motion. DTCG-style ($value, $type, $description); references use {group.token}. Values are PROVISIONAL until the design system is finalized with Claude Design (see DESIGN.md). Token names are a contract: keep them, change values. Build: npm run tokens.

brand.$description: Brand pink. Placeholder shade, finalized in the design system work. Every pink on the site derives from this one token. Must keep >= 4.5:1 contrast on color.bg.

on-brand.$description: Text and icons on a brand-pink surface (buttons).

bg.$description: Page background. The brand is black-based.

surface-raised.$description: Hover and raised elements on a surface.

text-muted.$description: Secondary text, captions. Must keep >= 4.5:1 on color.bg.

measure.$description: Dimension lines, rulers, technical data: the workshop's measuring language.

display.$description: Headlines. Must support Latin Extended (Hungarian ő ű Ő Ű).

body.$description: Running text and UI. Must support Latin Extended.

mono.$description: Prices, sizes, measurements, technical captions. Use tabular numbers.

variation-text.$description: font-variation-settings for all text. A direction pins axes here (Bodoni Moda: "opsz" 12, so its hairlines survive on 1x screens).

variation-display.$description: font-variation-settings for large display type: section titles, hero, totals (Bodoni Moda: "opsz" 20).

display.$description: Headings in the display face. Each direction sets its own: Big Shoulders 800, Bodoni 400.

text.$description: Type scale. The larger steps are fluid (CSS clamp).

brand-glow.$description: Glow of brand elements (direction A uses a neon glow). Plain CSS box-shadow value.
